## Checklist
- [ ] Debug and Release x64 build.
- [ ] `HarnessTests.exe -tse=windowed,audio`, `tests/python` and `tests/adapter` pass.
- [ ] Behaviour changes have a test, and `docs/api_spec.md`, `adapter/README.md` or `docs/decisions.md` are updated where they describe it.
- [ ] New source files start with an SPDX header; code copied from AppleWin is marked as described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] No disk images, ROM images or other copyrighted game or system files are added.
- [ ] The agent still gets only a player's view and controls (README, "Fair play").
